data.name: Fenelia
data.gender_notes: Fenelia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'fenelus', meaning 'little stranger' or 'wanderer'. In early Christian tradition, this name was given to children born out of wedlock, symbolizing their journey through life as pilgrims or strangers in this world. The name Fenelia carries the meaning “Little stranger, wanderer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fenelia usually hope their child will grow to embody little stranger, wanderer and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Φενελία
in_greek.meaning: Φενελία σημαίνει: ο Θεός είναι η ασπίδα μου
